_comment: Authored stand-ins for the About-them agent, injected by the demo loader because the agent web-searches real people and these people do not exist. Written to the agent's exact output schema and, more importantly, to its exact completeness distribution: full for the two people with real public footprints, partial for the three with a profile page and little else, thin for the two running pre-launch companies, empty for the three who are private individuals. Three empty blocks out of ten is not a gap. It is the identity check failing closed, which is a real property of the tool and worth a viewer seeing. Fields obey the agent's caps: one_line under 25 words, current_focus and background one to two sentences, at most three things_to_know at under 25 words each, and no generic descriptors.

marguerite.one_line: Angel investor and former COO of Ardith Staffing, which sold to a healthcare services group in 2021.
marguerite.current_focus: Invests personally at pre-seed in vertical software for healthcare operations, typically writing the first institutional check. Serves on four boards.
marguerite.background: Spent eleven years in healthcare staffing operations before moving to investing, the last six as COO. Has written publicly about why operators make impatient investors.
three_things_to_know: Publishes an annual letter on why most vertical software companies underprice their first year
Was an operator before an investor, and her questions tend to be about process rather than metrics
Sits on four boards and has said she takes on no more than one new one a year

theo.one_line: Director of engineering at Corvia, a freight logistics company, where he has led platform teams since 2019.
theo.current_focus: Runs the platform organization at Corvia. Spoke at an infrastructure conference last year on incremental migration of systems that cannot be taken offline.
theo.background: Engineering roles at two logistics companies before Corvia. Has managed the same core team for several years, which several public writeups of his talks make a point of noting.
three_things_to_know: His conference talk argued that the interesting part of a migration is the months before the cutover
Has managed the same platform team at Corvia for roughly five years
Writes infrequently but is cited by others in the logistics engineering community

nkechi.one_line: Senior software engineer working on data infrastructure at a large technology company.
nkechi.background: Six years in engineering, the last three focused on migrations of high-volume write paths. Published a widely shared writeup of a five-month dual-write migration.
three_things_to_know: Her migration writeup is the piece of public writing she is most often cited for
No public indication she is looking for a new role

hana.one_line: In-house technical recruiter at Northlane, focused on senior and staff engineering hires.
hana.current_focus: Recruits for Northlane's platform and infrastructure teams. Her public posts are largely open-role announcements.
three_things_to_know: Has been at Northlane for roughly two years, per her profile

rosalind.one_line: Owner and lead veterinarian at Cascade Veterinary in Tacoma, in practice since 1999.
rosalind.background: Founded Cascade Veterinary after several years in a larger multi-site practice. The clinic's site lists soft-tissue surgery and senior animal care as her focus.
three_things_to_know: Clinic bio notes twenty-six years in practice and a particular interest in geriatric care
Cascade is independent and has stayed two-vet, in a region where most practices have been acquired

dane.one_line: Co-founder of Thicket. Worked as a veterinary technician for several years before moving into software sales.

josiah.one_line: Founder of an early-stage company. Limited public information available beyond a landing page.
